script_text: Stop! Aquarius, your private sector is activating a major financial opportunity right now. Pause whatever you are doing immediately. Saturn forms a harmonious sextile to the Moon in your 8th House, stabilizing shared resources while Mercury and Venus glow bright in the 7th House of Partnerships. As an Air sign ruled by Uranus, you crave truth. For those attached, a deep conversation clears old resentment regarding money or intimacy, finally allowing genuine vulnerability with them. For single Aquarius, a financially stable prospect appears through mutual friends. Career: Your long-term planning finally pays off. Uranus in the 10th House rewards preparation made months ago with a promotion or raise. However, do not lend money before evening or the debt may not return, protecting your peace instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss a cosmic alignment coming your way. Stay lucky.
